temporary_streams.idea_definition_status: New Greek IDs are required outputs of approved implementation; existing CYP volunteer ID is reused.
temporary_streams.gate: Read actual has_idea plus this active episode and its original deadline in the existing local money-rate calculation. Missing spirit, expired deadline or cancelled episode contributes zero even if a monthly cache is stale.
temporary_streams.cleanup: On removal, expiry, cancellation or loss of programme eligibility, remove the stream immediately. On return of a party restore only the remaining original lifetime, never another full duration. Never replay setup fees, doctrine, XP or units.
temporary_streams.refresh_on_removal: Idea on_remove and the original one-shot expiry callback clear this contribution and request a refresh of native expense/display rates before the next treasury application. Do not wait for monthly reconciliation or run an extra treasury debit. Repeated cleanup is a no-op.
removal_order: Clear only the active budget episode, preserving the original issue/expiry clock
Set this stream contribution to zero
Refresh calculate_additional_expense_rate, update_display and update_money_dirty_variable without applying treasury a second time
temporary_streams.expiry_clock: Schedule one hidden expiry event at original issue for the stated maximum duration. It marks the immutable instance expired even while the spirit is absent. Party restoration before that event may restore only the remaining lifetime; after that event it restores neither spirit nor cost. Never reschedule the original expiry. Mission-bound programmes without a fixed maximum end on actual mission closure instead.
temporary_streams.calculation: Reset this contribution to zero before every calculation. Add it to the country expense accumulator exactly once; repeated recalculation must not accumulate a previous total. No weekly world, sanctions or relationship scans.

economy.basis: Maximum structurally compatible one-time price sum within this section, constant-GDP reference. Not a treasury forecast or a combination of incompatible focuses.

defence.basis: Maximum structurally compatible one-time price sum within this section, constant-GDP reference. Not a treasury forecast or a combination of incompatible focuses.

limits: Country GDP changes, native spending laws, active party/leader, debts, bilateral funding and native payment boundaries affect the real result. Spirit presence, money refresh, weekly boundaries and shortfalls must be tested in the actual engine after implementation.
